adjudication.rationale: In EmbedController#best, when no TopicEmbed exists it unconditionally enqueues `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ..., embed_url: embed_url)` and renders `loading`. The loading template (`app/views/embed/loading.html.erb`) forces `document.location.reload()` every 30s, which will hit `embed#best` again and enqueue another `retrieve_topic` job each time until the embed is created. Although `TopicRetriever#retrieve` has a 60s redis throttle to skip the actual fetch, the jobs themselves are still created repeatedly by every visitor, so the embedded page can generate an unbounded number of queued jobs over time.
